message.content: {"summary":"You developed a well-conceived mission with strong Australian relevance, clearly identifying key stakeholders and conducting solid STK orbit and ground access analyses. Your introduction and conclusions were clear and aligned with your operational goals. To reach the highest grade bands, you need to substantiate your engineering claims—especially regarding drag-sail deorbit calculations—and significantly improve report presentation by eliminating raw website copies, formatting citations formally, and properly captioning all figures.","criteria":{"C1":"You achieved Accomplished by thoroughly articulating your mission concept and rationale in the Introduction. Citing fluid lensing technology and targeting clear stakeholders (CSIRO, BOM) gave strong Australian context. You also effectively justified your single-spacecraft architecture. To sustain this standard, maintain this strong link between technical choices and mission needs across the entire technical report.","C2":"You covered core mission elements adequately using STK for access periods and selecting an appropriate SSO and launch vehicle. To reach Accomplished, avoid raw copied tables in 'Mission Design', derive orbital parameters rather than lifting values from external sites, complete cut-off sentences in 'Mission Duration & EOL', and provide quantitative engineering calculations (e.g., ballistic coefficient and drag area sizing) verifying the 25-year de-orbit rule.","C3":"You reached Accomplished by delivering a coherent summary that accurately reflects your mission findings. You properly identified the launch vehicle development risk (Vega E) and synthesized your ground station selection (Mt Pleasant) relative to reef-monitoring operations. To progress further, include more explicit quantitative performance metrics in your final takeaways.","C4":"Your report met Adequate criteria by following standard section headings, but requires substantial refinement to look professional. Uncaptioned graphics (such as 'STK 3D view of orbit'), unedited Wikipedia tables retaining external citation tags, and a bibliography composed of bare URLs detracted from your presentation. For Accomplished, format all references in an approved academic style (e.g., IEEE) and number and caption all figures and tables.","next_steps":["Calculate and show quantitative de-orbit proof in 'Mission Duration & EOL' (using ballistic coefficient and drag area equations) to verify compliance with the 25-year standard.","Replace copied Wikipedia manifest tables with your own original, synthesized trade-off comparison table evaluating launch vehicle options.","Format your bibliography using a standard academic style (e.g., IEEE/AIAA) with complete metadata, and add formal, numbered captions to every figure and table."]}
